simple.meaning: אָחַז (ʼâchaz) appears 68 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a brother in the family line and in connection with flocks. The occurrence trail connects the name with an offering.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Genesis, Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, and 15 more, beginning at Genesis 22:13. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family, family line, flock, offering, land, Egypt.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows אָחַז through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.
